text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I couldn't take center stage today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: But it was a good live.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts really are amazing,
though. I
was so excited.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to sing and dance in
front of
everyone is super fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: Being center stage will surely be ...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next time,
I'll make sure I'm in
the
center!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm aiming to be a top
Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her determination renewed, Smart
Falcon seems
full of enthusiasm as we
discuss our path moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've got a question for you! What's the
first thing
a freshly-debuted Umadol has
to do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Well, actually, you're not entirely
wrong!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But Umadols are all about practical
experience!
I've gotta get more fans by
putting on real
concerts! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run tons of races, and this time,
I'll take
center stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
I'm still limited in the races I
can
compete in.
choice_data_list: Then first, we've gotta win a Maid...
Then first, we've gotta win a Maid...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Runners who don't win their debut can only
compete in maiden races. Once
we're over that hurdle, we can move on
to more ambitious
goals...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she places first in those races, she'll
naturally
attract more attention.
choice_data_list: Let's take 1st place in an even hi...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! ☆ I just gotta win, then!
choice_data_list: Win at least two races, and popula...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's make everybody remember the

up-and-coming Umadol, Falco! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on winning at least two
races at the Pre-Open level or higher
during junior year to
jump-start Smart
Falcon's fame.
